role: Clinical service coordinator at a home oxygen supplier, reviewing each completed delivery and installation visit record before it is closed or followed up
setting: A regional home oxygen service delivers concentrators, portable units and cylinders to patients' homes against an active prescription. Each visit produces a structured record covering the prescription and order, what the technician left and installed, the home fire-safety assessment, equipment fault history and the supply plan. The coordinator checks one visit record at a time. They decide whether the delivery matched the prescription, how far the order was fulfilled, how long on-site oxygen will last, how many safety hazards remain open, and what should happen to the record next.

rx_match.instructions: Delivered equipment matches the active prescription's modality and flow rate.

next_step.instructions: What should happen to this delivery record next?

criteria.close_record: No outstanding items, checks or paperwork; file as complete.
criteria.chase_paperwork: Only a signature or document is missing; no return visit.
criteria.hold_confirm: One fact needs phone confirmation before closing or rebooking.
criteria.book_revisit: Return visit needed for items or setup, not same-day.
criteria.urgent_dispatch: Same-day visit needed because supply or safety is critical.

fulfilment.instructions: How much of the ordered delivery was actually fulfilled on this visit?

criteria.nothing_delivered: No prescribed items were left on site during this visit.
criteria.items_short: Some items left, but at least one prescribed item missing.
criteria.setup_incomplete: All items left; install, testing or training not finished.
criteria.fully_complete: All items left and every install check logged complete.

supply_runway.instructions: How long will on-site oxygen last at prescribed usage?
criteria: Critical: under 12 hours at prescribed flow and hours
Short: 12 to 48 hours at prescribed usage
Adequate: over 48 hours, up to 7 days
Ample: over 7 days, or concentrator verified working

open_hazards.instructions: How many home safety hazards remain unresolved at visit close?
criteria: No unresolved hazards at visit close
Exactly one unresolved hazard at visit close
Two unresolved hazards at visit close
Three unresolved hazards at visit close
Four or more unresolved hazards at visit close

factors.name: rx_alignment
factors.description: How the delivered equipment relates to the active prescription: exact match, flow setting differs from prescribed flow, wrong modality (e.g. cylinders only where a concentrator is prescribed), or the prescription had expired before the visit date.

factors.name: items_shortfall
factors.description: Gap between items_ordered and items_left: none, one SKU short or under quantity, several SKUs short, or nothing left (no access or patient declined).

factors.name: setup_state
factors.description: Completion of installation checks: all logged, training not given, flow or alarm test not logged, or the install_checks object entirely null.

factors.name: supply_hours
factors.description: True hours of oxygen available on site at prescribed flow and daily hours, derived from cylinder sizes, fill levels and whether a working concentrator is installed; values cluster near the 12, 48 and 168 hour boundaries often.

factors.name: concentrator_fault
factors.description: Equipment fault log shows a concentrator fault code raised during or shortly before the visit (alarming signal).

factors.name: fault_mitigated
factors.description: When a fault is present, a later fault-log entry shows retest_passed true or a replacement serial was swapped in on the same visit; sampled independently so the fault appears with and without mitigation about equally.

factors.name: hazards_found
factors.description: Number of hazards recorded on the site assessment (smoker in household, open flame appliance, no smoke alarm, tubing trip risk, cylinder stored near heat).

factors.name: hazard_mitigation
factors.description: Whether hazards that were found were mostly resolved on the visit (fire-break valves fitted, cylinders relocated, alarm fitted); each recorded hazard carries status resolved_on_visit or open, so alarming hazard codes appear resolved about half the time.

factors.name: hazard_status_missing
factors.description: One recorded hazard has status null because it was not rechecked before departure, leaving the open-hazard count on a boundary.

factors.name: handover_gap
factors.description: Patient signature null or handover_at timestamp missing while everything else is complete; a paperwork-only gap.

factors.name: timeline_out_of_order
factors.description: install_checks.completed_at earlier than visit.arrived_at, or departed_at before arrived_at, casting doubt on whether checks really happened on this visit.

factors.name: next_delivery
factors.description: State of the next scheduled delivery relative to the supply runway: booked before supply runs out, booked after it runs out, or not booked; a timely booking mitigates short supply.

factors.name: dependency_level
factors.description: Prescribed usage pattern: ambulatory only, nocturnal, or continuous 24-hour use; changes how far a given cylinder stock lasts.

factors.name: billing_hold
factors.description: Decoy: account carries a billing hold or arrears flag that looks alarming but has no bearing on clinical supply, fulfilment or safety.

sections.name: order
sections.description: Order id, prescription (modality, flow_lpm, hours_per_day, rx_expiry), items_ordered list of sku and qty, and account flags.

sections.name: visit
sections.description: Visit id and date, arrived_at, departed_at, items_left list with sku, qty and serial, install_checks object, patient_signature, handover_at.

sections.name: site_assessment
sections.description: assessed_at timestamp and a hazards list, each with a hazard code, status and fix code.

sections.name: equipment
sections.description: Installed concentrator serial and flow_setting_lpm, fault_log entries, and cylinders_on_site with size code and fill_pct.

sections.name: supply_plan
sections.description: Next delivery date, delivery window and the route day assigned.

rendering_notes: rx_alignment: compare order.prescription.modality and flow_lpm with visit.items_left SKUs and equipment.concentrator.flow_setting_lpm; rx_expired shows as order.prescription.rx_expiry earlier than visit.visit_date. Never include a match flag. items_shortfall: visible only by comparing order.items_ordered with visit.items_left; nothing_left gives an empty items_left list and access_achieved false. setup_state: visit.install_checks has booleans flow_verified, alarm_tested, training_given and a completed_at time; individual booleans are false or null, and checks_null makes the whole object null. supply_hours is never stated. It must be derived from equipment.cylinders_on_site (size codes such as CD 460 L, ZD 300 L, HX 2300 L with fill_pct), order.prescription.flow_lpm and hours_per_day (driven by dependency_level). A concentrator counts only if installed with no unresolved fault. concentrator_fault adds an equipment.fault_log entry with a code such as LOW_PURITY or HIGH_PRESSURE. fault_mitigated adds a later entry with retest_passed true, or a second concentrator serial in items_left. hazards_found and hazard_mitigation shape the site_assessment.hazards list; each entry has a status of open or resolved_on_visit and a fix code (firebreak_fitted, cylinder_relocated, alarm_fitted, or null). hazard_status_missing sets one status to null. handover_gap sets visit.patient_signature to null or omits handover_at. timeline_out_of_order puts install_checks.completed_at before visit.arrived_at, or makes departed_at precede arrived_at. next_delivery shows as supply_plan.next_delivery_date, or null if not_booked, and is compared against the derived runway. billing_hold appears as order.account.billing_hold true with an arrears_gbp amount; it is a decoy. Other decoys: customer satisfaction rating, technician id, route day, and prior visit count; none bear on the answers. No free-text fields. No field may state fulfilment status, urgency, risk level, hazard totals, supply hours or a recommended action.
